text:
Type: white enamel pitcher vase
Use: holding fresh flowers or branches on a table, shelf or windowsill; kitchen, dining room, living room
Style: farmhouse, Scandinavian, rustic
Materials: glossy white enamelled steel
Colors: bright white
Shape: tall conical jug body that widens toward the base, angled rim with a pouring spout, large curved loop handle, tall but light
Feel: fresh, homely, clean, charming
Goes with: wildflowers, light wood, linen, white or sage walls; farmhouse, Scandinavian or cottage kitchens and dining rooms

product.name: SOCKERRT
product.description: Can also be used as a jug.
